title: Unleavened Bread
summary: Unleavened bread was associated with Israel’s hasty departure from Egypt and with consecrated remembrance before the Lord.
background: Leaven often became a teaching symbol because it spreads through dough. Scripture can use that imagery negatively for corrupting influence or positively for pervasive kingdom growth, depending on context.
teachingHelp: Help listeners avoid flattening every use of leaven into one meaning. Explain the immediate passage and how the image functions there.
